tabs.tab_title: Can I buy the kit without installation?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. The DIY kit is the core offer. We can supply the complete kit for you or your installer to assemble.
Delivery timing depends on the kit, roof type and location. We confirm the expected lead time in your quote before you order.

tabs.tab_title: What information do you need to quote?
tabs.tab_content: Approximate width, length and postcode are enough to start. Photos or plans help us confirm the right setup faster.
Aluminium is lightweight, corrosion resistant and gives the structure clean lines. Your final beam and post sizes are determined by the project requirements.
